tagline: Syn3h, native in the browser: its vehicles, its physics, its lobby and its look.
deadline: Demo: Sunday noon Pacific, Coeur d'Alene
headline: Release 5 is live and verified. Clouds, temporal antialiasing, saved-world moons and touch minimap clearance are public. All 1,156 tests, frozen checks, primary-site multiplayer and eight public vehicle drives passed.

previews.title: Play the current build
previews.detail: Opens on the Syn3h lobby. WASD drives, Space opens wings, Shift brakes, C changes camera. For King of the Hill choose Multiplayer, set the mode, then raise Bots under Worlds and drive the road to the summit.

previews.title: Fly the Syn3h jet
previews.detail: R thrust, Space switches hover and flight, S pulls up, A and D bank.

previews.title: Classic buggy
previews.detail: A second buggy with its own physics, kept as a second choice.

previews.title: A different world
previews.detail: Every seed moves the volcano, the mesas and the road.

milestones.title: Research and proposal
milestones.detail: Reference games dissected, stack chosen.

milestones.title: Foundation
milestones.detail: Three.js on WebGPU, Rapier at a fixed 50 Hz, shared slider registry, headless smoke test.

milestones.title: Milestone 1: buggy physics on Martian terrain
milestones.detail: Buggy handling, driving on a procedural landscape. First preview link.

milestones.title: Procedural volcano world from a shared seed
milestones.detail: Dunes, mesas and a climbable volcano generated locally in under 150 ms. Lava, roads and flames follow.

milestones.title: Multiplayer with ramming
milestones.detail: Room server, remote players, physical proxies so vehicles can shove each other, shared sliders.

milestones.title: Alien sky, sun and shadows
milestones.detail: Live time of day and scattering sliders. Nothing baked.

milestones.title: Laser tag
milestones.detail: Lasers, tagging by ram or shot, scores.

milestones.title: Bots that chase and ram you
milestones.detail: Merged. Set the bots slider to drop them in.

milestones.title: Lava, flames, embers and smoke effects
milestones.detail: Merged as modules. Placement on the volcano comes with the second terrain pass.

milestones.title: Sound engine, phone controls, first start screen
milestones.detail: Merged. The start screen is being replaced by the Syn3h lobby.

milestones.title: Roads up the volcano and lava layout
milestones.detail: Merged. Switchback road to the rim, ring road, lava lake, rivers and vents placed. Lava is not drawn yet.

milestones.title: Syn3h buggy on Syn3h physics, at full size
milestones.detail: Merged. Drives, jumps, glides on its wings and lands. Needs your verdict on feel.

milestones.title: Syn3h interface: lobby, sliding panels, logo, music
milestones.detail: Merged: lobby, depth-slide panels, logo, fonts, menu, host lock, Space Station music. In-game HUD panels are a best guess without reference shots.

milestones.title: Syn3h camera
milestones.detail: Merged with your shipped defaults. C cycles modes, wheel zooms, Z scopes.

milestones.title: Multiplayer identity and bots for everyone
milestones.detail: Vehicle kind, colours and name tags replicate. The host's bots appear for all players and can be rammed and shot.

milestones.title: Syn3h jet and hovercraft: tuned in game
milestones.detail: Merged and flown in game. Sky reflections on the chrome. Jet control response softened for keyboards.

milestones.title: Wing glow, lava floating, rescue resets
milestones.detail: Merged. Wings glow in the accent colour. The buggy floats and paddles out of lava. Falling off the world returns you to spawn.

milestones.title: Phone performance and load time
milestones.detail: Merged: graphics levels, crash recovery, F3 overlay. Load time unchanged at about half a second on desktop. Real phones untested.

milestones.title: Minimap, loading screen, control help
milestones.detail: Merged. Help shows per vehicle; H reopens it.

milestones.title: Tank
milestones.detail: Merged as a vehicle by URL only: ?vehicle=tank.

milestones.title: King of the Hill
milestones.detail: Merged and checked in the preview. Hold the rim alone to score; contested scores nothing; lava takes you out and credits whoever knocked you in.

milestones.title: Vehicle effects
milestones.detail: Merged: tyre tracks, dust, landing puffs, thrusters, headlights. Trails are new, not from Syn3h.

milestones.title: Bots tuned for the Syn3h buggy, QA sweep, deploy rehearsal
milestones.detail: Bots predict, spread out, follow roads and escape lava. 24 of 24 QA cases pass. Local Cloudflare run passed 22 of 22 checks.

milestones.title: Names, loading messages, share card, credits
milestones.detail: New seeded names and 40 loading messages. Share image and icons ready; need the public address.

milestones.title: Island world with lava and fire
milestones.detail: Merged. Volcano at the origin, lava to the horizon, eight coastal spawn pads, rock fangs round the summit, lava and vents drawn. 75 ms to generate.

milestones.title: Hovercraft handling
milestones.detail: Merged. Assisted glide holds clearance over dunes, slopes, lava and sea with zero hull-through-ground samples. The unassisted controller is one slider away.

milestones.title: Demo features
milestones.detail: Merged: join by QR (J), attract mode, presentation HUD (P), winner banner.

milestones.title: Sound
milestones.detail: Merged: a voice per vehicle, positional bots, wind, lava, landing thumps, King of the Hill and menu cues. Measured, not yet heard by anyone.

milestones.title: Public repository
milestones.detail: github.com/terran-labs/syn3h is public with eight milestone tags.

milestones.title: Live preview no longer resets under you
milestones.detail: A merge now shows a 'new build available' notice, and a reload puts you back where you were with the same vehicle, wings, camera and room.

milestones.title: Frame rate on real hardware
milestones.detail: Headed Chrome on this M2 Max: about 8 ms a frame at 1280 x 720. Headless numbers were misleading. Quiet-machine and phone readings still to come.

milestones.title: Stable demo channel
milestones.detail: A frozen build and its server exist and pass the multiplayer checks. The preview broker refuses to start a third service for this workspace, so there is no link yet.

milestones.title: Public hosting on Cloudflare
milestones.detail: One Durable Object per room, so friends can join from anywhere.

milestones.title: Demo rehearsal
milestones.detail: Full run through on the demo hardware and network, with a fallback plan.

milestones.title: Public deployment
milestones.detail: Rehearsed locally under Cloudflare's runtime. Waiting on your Cloudflare access.

workers.name: Syn3h :: UX

workers.name: Syn3h :: Vehicles (Codex 1)

workers.name: Syn3h :: Bots, Performance & QA (Codex 2)
workers.detail: A physics crash when bots and the graphics level change together, then bots on the island.

workers.name: Syn3h :: Multiplayer

workers.name: Syn3h :: Buggy
workers.detail: Next-gen tyre model merged. Waiting for you to drive it.

workers.name: Syn3h :: Jet
workers.detail: Waiting for your feel report. Proposes an altitude hold for hover on keyboards.

workers.name: Syn3h :: Classic Buggy (paused)
workers.detail: Paused for the night to relieve the machine. Twitchy at speed and small in the camera.

workers.name: Syn3h :: Tank (paused)
workers.detail: Paused for the night. It climbs walls: the tracks push about five times its weight.

decisions.title: Cloudflare sign-in on this machine
decisions.detail: npx wrangler login, or an API token. Plus a workers.dev name and a check that no Worker named syn3h exists. Release 1 ships within minutes.

decisions.title: Review the Tailscale access change
decisions.detail: The preview broker stopped serving at 5:00pm and will not restart until an administrator re-approves the tailnet scope.

decisions.title: Drive it and listen to it
decisions.detail: Your verdict on the buggy, and your ears on the sound, are still the real acceptance test.

decisions.title: Revoke three old API keys
decisions.detail: Google Maps, Bing and WRLD keys are committed in the public legacy-unity-syn3h-client repo.

strategy.title: Four seams, four builders
strategy.detail: Terrain, vehicles, networking and environment each sit behind one small interface, so they are built in parallel worktrees and merged without collisions.

strategy.title: A world is a seed plus sliders
strategy.detail: Every player generates the same terrain locally from one number. Nothing to download, so it loads fast, and every parameter is shared live.

strategy.title: Playable at every step
strategy.detail: Each milestone ends in a preview link. If time runs out, what is left over is polish.

strategy.title: Owner-authoritative netcode
strategy.detail: Each player simulates their own vehicle. Nearby remote vehicles stay physical, which is what makes ramming work.

accounts.name: Claude 1
accounts.detail: Weekly limit reset by the owner Saturday afternoon. Runs the orchestrator and three builders.

accounts.name: Codex 1, 2 and 3
accounts.detail: One builder each, directed by the orchestrator.

vehiclesNote: Every vehicle has been checked by automated tests, scripted drives and screenshots. None has been driven by hand yet. Sound is merged for all five but has not been heard by anyone. Each vehicle has its own workspace for conversations about look and feel.

vehicles.name: Syn3h buggy
vehicles.role: Primary vehicle, default in the lobby
vehicles.summary: Full size. Drives, jumps, glides on its wings and lands. Needs your hands on it.

aspects.name: Model
aspects.detail: Full size, with its wheels, axles and wing surface. Body and accent colours apply.

aspects.name: Physics
aspects.detail: A next-gen tyre model is now on by default (grip up to a limit, then sliding; ABS; speed-limited steering); buggy.nextGen off restores the simpler equations exactly.

aspects.name: Wings
aspects.detail: Flight model with stall, the flight-slip and powered-loop options and gear retract. Wings glow in the accent colour.

aspects.name: Lava and rescue
aspects.detail: Floats and paddles out of lava. Returns to its spawn pad if it falls off the world, and is set upright after 3 seconds stuck on its roof.

aspects.name: Effects
aspects.detail: Tyre tracks, wheel dust, landing puffs, headlights at night.

aspects.name: Sound
aspects.detail: Synthesised electric-turbine voice with tyre roar and slip squeal. Merged. Measured for level and clipping, but not yet heard by anyone.

aspects.name: Multiplayer and bots
aspects.detail: Kind, colours, name tag and effects replicate. Bots drive this vehicle.

aspects.name: Checked by
aspects.detail: Scripted climb of the volcano road to the summit, dune jump, slalom and sprint captures, and the QA sweep on three seeds.

aspects.name: Known issues
aspects.detail: The rightward pull under throttle is gone with the new tyre model. Lava floating is on. Changing vehicle in the lobby reloads the page. The new tyre model has not been driven by hand.

vehicles.name: Syn3h jet
vehicles.summary: Chrome and the purple cockpit. Takes off in hover, transitions to flight, lands on its gear. Flown for over a minute including two crashes.

aspects.name: Model
aspects.detail: True size, with paint, chrome, cockpit glass and animated landing gear. Sky reflections on the metal.

aspects.name: Physics
aspects.detail: Mass 200, hover and flight thrust, hull and nozzle position, drag of 0.0001.

aspects.name: Hover and flight
aspects.detail: Space switches modes. Gear folds in flight. Stall, lift and thinner air with altitude are modelled.

aspects.name: Control response
aspects.detail: Softened to 0.3 for keyboards: at full authority a half-second tap pitched the nose about 100 degrees. Set jet.controlResponse to 1 for full authority.

aspects.name: Effects
aspects.detail: Main thruster glow and exhaust by throttle, hover thrusters, dust near the ground.

aspects.name: Sound
aspects.detail: Hover hum crossfading to a roar with throttle. Merged. Measured for level and clipping, but not yet heard by anyone.

aspects.name: Multiplayer
aspects.detail: A remote jet appears with the right model, colours and gear animation. Bots do not fly it.

aspects.name: Checked by
aspects.detail: 65 seconds of forward flight, a crash into the volcano and a ditch in the lava sea, both recovered with Space then R.

aspects.name: Known issues
aspects.detail: Flying controls are not guessable without the help panel (H).

vehicles.name: Syn3h hovercraft
vehicles.summary: Glides about 2.5 m above ground, lava and sea. The easy vehicle.

aspects.name: Model
aspects.detail: Spoilers, cockpit and rear glow, in the standard vehicle paint.

aspects.name: Assisted glide
aspects.detail: Default. Four hover samples under the hull, damped lift, gentle banking, braking over one second, a collision hull that matches the model.

aspects.name: Unassisted mode
aspects.detail: hover.assist 0 turns the assistance off. It still clips steep slopes.

aspects.name: Effects
aspects.detail: Ground dust under the craft, suppressed over liquid, with a puff on entering it.

aspects.name: Sound
aspects.detail: Fan drone with a ground-effect whoosh. Merged. Measured for level and clipping, but not yet heard by anyone.

aspects.name: Multiplayer
aspects.detail: A remote hovercraft appears with the right model and colours.

aspects.name: Checked by
aspects.detail: 7,153 samples across dunes, slopes, drops, the lava lake and the sea on two seeds, with the hull never touching the ground.

vehicles.name: Classic buggy
vehicles.summary: A second buggy with its own physics. Twitchier than the Syn3h buggy at speed.

aspects.name: Model
aspects.detail: Its own body and wheels.

aspects.name: Physics
aspects.detail: Wheel radius 0.30, wheelbase 1.6 m.

aspects.name: Wings
aspects.detail: Glide with stall, airbrakes, self-levelling, lava thermals.

aspects.name: Lava and rescue
aspects.detail: Same floating and rescue behaviour as the Syn3h buggy.

aspects.name: Effects
aspects.detail: Tyre tracks, dust and headlights.

aspects.name: Sound
aspects.detail: Its own voice. Merged. Measured for level and clipping, but not yet heard by anyone.

aspects.name: Multiplayer
aspects.detail: Replicates like the others.

aspects.name: Known issues
aspects.detail: Rolls over in hard turns at speed; ground grip was reduced, but it remains lively. Top speed runs far past the speed slider.

aspects.name: Lead's first look
aspects.detail: A 1.5 second turn at 33 m/s put it on two wheels. It is about 3 percent of the frame width in the chase camera. Lane paused for the night.

vehicles.name: Tank
vehicles.role: By link only, not in the lobby
vehicles.summary: Added last and kept out of the lobby until you ask for it.

aspects.name: Model
aspects.detail: Hull and tread meshes with a track texture.

aspects.name: Physics
aspects.detail: Motor, grip, skid steering and braking equations. The six jointed track bodies are replaced by six contact casts on one body, so mass, inertia and suspension are approximations.

aspects.name: Behaviours
aspects.detail: Drives, reverses, pivots in place, loses traction in the air, recovers when inverted.

aspects.name: Effects
aspects.detail: Headlights only. No track marks or dust yet.

aspects.name: Sound
aspects.detail: Diesel rumble with track clatter. Merged. Measured for level and clipping, but not yet heard by anyone.

aspects.name: Multiplayer
aspects.detail: Allowed over the network, but not tested with two players.

aspects.name: Checked by
aspects.detail: Five physics tests and one smoke run on the island. No long drive, no climb of the volcano.

aspects.name: Lead's first look
aspects.detail: It climbs walls: six tracks push about five times its weight, and it pitched to 68 degrees on a ridge and stayed. Track pods dangle when they leave the ground. Lane paused for the night.

knownIssues.title: Physical devices still need review
knownIssues.detail: Automated Chrome and WebKit checks do not establish performance, listening quality or QR entry on the owner’s phone or iPad.

knownIssues.title: Water is opaque from above
knownIssues.detail: Depth colour does not reveal submerged ground or objects.

knownIssues.title: Aircraft avoidance is unfinished
knownIssues.detail: The response study produced two escapes and two harmful catches. Ground dodge and bot gear remain available.

knownIssues.title: Screen-space lighting has limits
knownIssues.detail: Surfaces outside the view cannot contribute to indirect light.

knownIssues.title: Startup timing remains under observation
knownIssues.detail: Earlier stale-state failures under heavy load remain unexplained. Accepted dry seam checks cover steady-state driving after bounded readiness.

knownIssuesTrunk.title: Rendering limits
knownIssuesTrunk.detail: Clouds do not cast terrain shadows. Water, grass and particles skip temporal history to avoid ghosting.

knownIssuesTrunk.detail: Tank and hovercraft studies still need the owner’s selection. Smooth near-camera terrain remains deferred.
